comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Chromatic project is ready; need the stories package name confirmed with design-system before landing.

content.text: Chromatic project is ready; need the stories package name confirmed with design-system before landing.

Notification toasts have four visual variants and a stacking policy that only exists as tribal knowledge in the Notifications channel. Design reviews keep regressing spacing when engineers guess the rules.

Add Storybook stories for success, warning, error, and info toasts, plus a multi-toast canvas that exercises the 3-toast max stack, 280ms enter/exit, and bottom-right collision with the help FAB. Document the z-index band 1200–1290 in the story description.
Acceptance: stories render under Chromatic, stacking story matches the Figma density spec within 2px, and the Notifications README links to the Storybook path.
